items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Is The Latest Video Game To Get The Movie Treatment
items.summary: Paramount Pictures will develop the film and CD Projekt Red will produce.
items.content:
Paramount Pictures will develop the film and CD Projekt Red will produce.

CD Projekt Red Add Engadget on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover Movie adaptations of video games are currently doing a brisk business, and today brings a new title into the fold. Deadline reports that Paramount Pictures is working on a live-action film set in the world of Cyberpunk 2077 , a narrative-driven RPG from CD Projekt Red. The game developer is attached to produce the movie along with Lorenzo di Bonaventura, whose past producer credits on action movies run the gamut from Red and Shooter to The Meg and several Michael Bay Transformers flicks.

It's unclear whether this is a separate endeavor from the early-stage news of a production deal with Anonymous Content announced back in 2023. Today's report is also very preliminary, with no suggestions of a plot or cast.

CD Projekt Red's Cyberpunk 2077 is already itself an adaptation of a tabletop game, so it's perhaps not a surprise that it would continue to inspire a ripple effect of retellings. The video game world of Night City has already provided fodder for the anime series Cyberpunk: Edgerunners on Netflix, which is about to return for a second season .

News about another video game adaptation can either be exciting or worrying, but this time it sounds pretty nova. An exclusive from Deadline reports that a live-action movie based on Cyberpunk 2077 is in the works at Paramount Pictures, with Lorenzo di Bonaventura set to produce.

News about another video game adaptation can either be exciting or worrying, but this time it sounds pretty nova. An exclusive from Deadline reports that a live-action movie based on Cyberpunk 2077 is in the works at Paramount Pictures, with Lorenzo di Bonaventura set to produce.

Cyberpunk 2077 is the award-winning, best-selling RPG developed by Poland-based game studio CD Projekt Red, based on the larger Cyberpunk universe that originated from Mike Pondsmith's cult-classic TTRPG. In the open-world video game, players take the role of "V," a mercenary (also called an edgerunner or cyberpunk) who ends up with a brain-eating chip in their brain, which contains the digitized mind of legendary rockerboy Johnny Silverhand. V must find a way to untangle their minds before the chip consumes their brain, while also fighting off the Arasaka Corporation, which designed it.

Players can choose their gender, sex, origins, and how they interact with other characters in the world. The setting, Night City, a corporate-run state, changes based on what the player does. It's unlikely we may get a canon V with set outcomes, but it's not impossible. The Baldur's Gate 3 TV show will apparently try a canon ending from Larian Studios' award-winning game (without the game writers' input), so it's not impossible that the Cyberpunk film will take a similar route.

Johnny Silverhand and V in Cyberpunk 2077. | Image: CD Projekt Red. However, Cyberpunk 2077 has already been successfully adapted into a motion picture of sorts. Japanese animators at Studio Trigger partnered with CD Projekt Red to produce Cyberpunk: Edgerunners , a critically acclaimed anime streaming exclusively on Netflix, with a second season on the way. It features new characters we never see in the video game, save for Adam Smasher. The Cyberpunk world has already proven it excels at telling stories in Night City that deepen our understanding of the dystopian, crime-riddled, cyberpsycho-infested streets. It doesn't have to connect directly. But there is a possibility we could see characters like Johnny Silverhand (Keanu Reeves) or Solomon Reed (Idris Elba) played by their real actors, who were the basis for their game models.

It was impressive enough that the game translated into animation so well, but as a live-action movie, with possible practical cybernetics and costumes, it could blow audiences' minds like a fried daemon upload. Cyberpunk 2077 has sold over 40 million copies, and the prequel DLC, Phantom Liberty, sold over 15 million copies. When Studio Trigger's anime released, there was a noticable uptick in player activity and newfound appreciation for the game's rich world, atmosphere, and characters. The community has never been healthier, and there's no telling the impact a theatrical release would have. There's no exact confirmation that it's coming to theaters instead of streaming, but we can only hope. I think Johnny Silverhand would want it to be on the silver screen.

As of yet, there's no official release window for the Cyberpunk 2077 film. We'll keep our eyes peeled for updates.

items.title: Live-Action CYBERPUNK 2077 Film in Development
items.summary: Night City is coming to the big screen, as a new report says Paramount Pictures is developing a live-action Cyberpunk 2077 movie.
items.content:
Quick Take Paramount Pictures is developing a live-action Cyberpunk 2077 movie. Lorenzo di Bonaventura ( Transformers ) will produce alongside the studio behind the video game, CD Projekt Red. It’s unknown if Paramount’s live-action Cyberpunk 2077 film will adapt the video game or just take place in Night City. This month, Cyberpunk 2077 will return to the small screen with season two of Netflix’s animated series Cyberpunk: Edgerunners . But soon we might get to see a live-action take on the franchise up on the big screen. A new report says Paramount Pictures is developing a Cyberpunk 2077 film set in the RPG world.

Deadline first reported Skydance’s Paramount Pictures is currently working on a Cyberpunk 2077 movie. Lorenzo di Bonaventura ( Transformers ) will produce alongside the studio behind the video game, CD Projekt Red. Whether it’s a straight adaptation of the game or a totally new story set in the same world is unknown. But considering Keanu Reeves’ role in the game, the smart money would certainly be on him appearing as the legendary rockstar/terrorist Johnny Silverhand in some capacity. Even if he doesn’t, the premise of the game, which takes place in the fictional Californian cyberpunk metropolis Night City, certainly makes for a compelling world on its own.

The best-selling game will certainly come with plenty of name recognition and a huge fanbase. The original Cyberpunk 2077 has sold over 40 million copies around the globe. Its expansion, Phantom Liberty , has also sold 15 million copies.

The film will also mark another big screen video game adaptation, one of Hollywood’s favorite modern day source materials. And it will be the latest IP to get a live-action film from Paramount Pictures, which is clearly focused on maximizing big name properties. Street Fighter will hit theaters this month . The studio is also developing Danny McBride’s G.I. Joe script for the big screen. Bradley Cooper has already signed on to star in it .

As for when we might see a live-action Cyberpunk 2077 film it sounds like development on the film is still in the very early stages. But with Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 premiering this month on October 20 there will be plenty Night City fun to hold fans over while we wait to learn more.

0 (Photo Credit: CD Projekt) CD Projekt Red ‘s open-world action blockbuster game, Cyberpunk 2077 , is getting a live-action movie adaptation. The action-adventure RPG initially launched in 2020. Despite its rough debut, the game eventually became a fan favorite.

A Cyberpunk 2077 movie is currently in development at Paramount Pictures , according to Deadline . Lorenzo di Bonaventura, known for the G.I. Joe series and Transformers: Rise of the Beasts, will serve as the producer alongside CD Projekt Red. An update on the director hasn’t been confirmed at the moment.

Plot details for the live-action film remain under wraps. However, it’s expected to mostly follow the game’s storyline, set in the futuristic metropolis of Night City in California.

Cyberpunk 2077 has won over fans in the nearly six years since its release. Ever since its original announcement more than a decade ago, it has been one of the most anticipated releases. However, its launch was met with an underwhelming response because of glitches, unexpected bugs, and many other problems.

The development team worked to fix the issues and eventually delivered a more polished dystopian sci-fi open-world experience with update 2.0 in 2023. The game was followed by its first major expansion, Phantom Liberty, in 2023. Fans responded positively to the improvements and the developers’ continued support, which coincided with stronger player reception and continued sales.

The Phantom Liberty expansion has sold 15 million copies. Meanwhile, Cyberpunk 2077 has sold more than 40 million copies worldwide. The sales numbers certainly make the game an attractive property for Paramount.

Besides CD Projekt Red’s game , Paramount is also developing two other major video game adaptations. Its Street Fighter film will hit theaters on October 16, 2026, while its Call of Duty film is scheduled for 2028. Based on Activision’s Call of Duty franchise, the film is scheduled to hit theaters on June 30, 2028.

The Cyberpunk 2077 movie does not yet have an official release date.

items.title: 'Cyberpunk 2077' Movie in the Works at Paramount From 'Transformers' Producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura
items.summary: The sci-fi RPG video game's producer CD Projekt Red will also serve as producer on the project, which previously featured Keanu Reeves.
items.content:
The sci-fi RPG video game’s producer CD Projekt Red will also serve as producer on the project

“Cyberpunk 2077,” the hit sci-fi video game from producer CD Projekt Red, is getting a feature film adaptation from Paramount and “Transformers” producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura, TheWrap has learned.

The Poland-based award-winning video game developer and the franchise rights holder CD Projekt Red will also serve as producers on the adaptation of their best-selling open-world RPG release.

Cyberpunk 2077 is an open-world action role-playing game set in Night City, a sprawling metropolis in a dystopian future where corporations wield enormous power and advanced technology has transformed everyday life. Players control V, a mercenary who takes on jobs for gangs, corporations and other powerful figures while trying to make a name for themselves. Divided by stark class and economic differences, the city exists in a society where cybernetic enhancements, artificial intelligence and virtual reality play a major role.

The original Cyberpunk 2077 has sold over 40 million copies internationally since its December 2020 release, and its Phantom Liberty expansion has seen an additional 15 million copies sold.

Video game adaptations have emerged as a reliable source of hits for Hollywood in recent years, helping shed the long-standing reputation of the genre as a critical and commercial minefield. HBO’s “The Last of Us” and Prime Video’s “Fallout” have been particularly successful in the streaming space, while “The Super Mario Bros. Movie” became a $1.3 billion-plus box office phenomenon in 2023 and “Five Nights at Freddy’s” became a major theatrical hit that same year.

Keanu Reeves, pictured above, is featured as a non-playable character in the Cyberpunk 2077 video game, but it remains unknown if the actor will return for the Paramount movie.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 is officially getting a live-action movie from Transformers producer
items.summary: CD Projekt Red's bestselling action RPG Cyberpunk 2077 is set to get a movie adaptation at Paramount, with Lorenzo di Bonaventura aboard to produce.
items.content:
Follow Empire on Google Sci-fi cinema has taken us to many weird, wonderful, and tech-suffused worlds over the years — from the dust-strewn, neon-lit Los Angeles of Blade Runner (and its 2049 and 2099 follow-ups) to The Matrix 's Mega City, Akira 's Neo-Tokyo, and RoboCop 's gritty, industrial Detroit. And soon, we'll be punching our ticket and hopping on the metro to add Night City to that list, as Deadline is reporting that CD Projekt Red's bestselling RPG Cyberpunk 2077 is gearing up to receive the blockbuster video game adaptation treatment at Paramount, with Transformers franchise mainstay Lorenzo Di Bonaventura attached to produce.

According to Deadline , Paramount's movie — which will join the likes of Sonic The Hedgehog , Halo , and the upcoming Street Fighter and Call Of Duty movies in the studio's game-to-screen stable — will be "a live-action film set in the Cyberpunk 2077 universe". As such, it sounds as if the project, which currently has no director or screenwriter attached, will be free to diverge from — or at least not directly adapt — CD Projekt Red's game. For those unfamiliar with said game, the plot broadly follows reluctantly biochip-enhanced mercenary V and their fight to take down nefarious Night City overlords the Asaka Corporation before their consciousness is fully overwritten by legendary rockstar/terrorist Johnny Silverhand... who just so happens to be played in the game by actual legendary rockstar, actor, and not-terrorist Keanu Reeves. As for where Paramount's Cyberpunk will head, the possibilities are pretty much endless. Heck, for all we know, maybe Idris Elba's charisma cannon of a government agent Solomon Reed, first introduced in the game's very popular Phantom Liberty expansion, might even make an appearance.

Given the previous success of Cyberpunk's anime offshoot, Edgerunners , along with the eye-catching aesthetic, epic sprawl and scope, and timely thematic concerns explored within the Cyberpunk universe, the prospect of seeing that world realised on the big screen — especially amid a new era of peak game-to-screen adaptations — is a tantalising one, indeed. The campaign for Keanu Reeves to reprise Johnny Silverhand in the movie starts here, friends. Grab your iron... let's mobilise!

By Michael McWhertor Published Oct 8, 2026, 2:59 PM EDT Michael McWhertor is a New York-based journalist and editor with more than 20 years of experience covering games, industry events, technology, movies, and TV. News CD Projekt Red and Paramount Pictures are bringing Nighty City to the big screen

Image: CD Projekt Red Cyberpunk 2077 Sign in to your Polygon.com account Add Us Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread 1 Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Johnny Silverhand is heading for the silver screen. CD Projekt Red's sci-fi role-playing game Cyberpunk 2077 is being adapted into a live-action movie at Paramount Pictures, according to a new report, with the longtime producer of the Transformers series overseeing the project. It's the latest video game adaptation from Paramount, which is also bringing Street Fighter and Call of Duty to live-action.

According to Deadline , Transformers producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura is attached to produce the movie alongside CD Projekt Red. Di Bonaventura is also working on a new Transformers live-action movie with Steven Spielberg and Michael Bay.

"We're excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise," said Michał Nowakowski, joint-CEO of CD Projekt, in a statement. "We look forward to sharing more details at the appropriate time."

Further info on the live-action Cyberpunk 2077 movie adaptation, including who will write, direct, and star in the film, weren't announced. But you know who'd be a good live-action Johnny Silverhand? Keanu Reeves. Just an idea!

The futuristic sci-fi story of Cyberpunk 2077 is centered on the mercenary V, who accepts a job to steal a one-of-a-kind implant said to be the key to immortality. V is imbued with a cybernetic biochip that contains the memory and personality of legendary rock star (and terrorist) Johnny Silverhand, and the two are forced to work together to save V's life. The game's backdrop is the stylized and dystopian Night City, which is run by the powerful Arasaka Corporation.

Cyberpunk 2077 was released in 2020 — more than eight years after its original announcement — in an infamously dire state. In the following years, CD Projekt Red vastly improved upon the game , making it a fan favorite and delivering on the franchise's original cyberpunk vision. Cyberpunk 2077 has sold more than 40 million copies, according to Nowakowski. The developer released an expansion, Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty , in 2025.

Image: CD Projekt Red CD Projekt and Japanese animation studio Trigger have already adapted the world of Cyberpunk 2077 into an animated series, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners , which began streaming on Netflix in 2022. A stand-alone sequel series, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 , is slated to premiere on Netflix on Oct. 20.

A video game sequel to Cyberpunk 2077 was announced in 2022 under the working title Project Orion. In May 2025, CD Projekt announced that the sequel, now known as Cyberpunk 2 , had entered pre-production. Cyberpunk 2 does not have an announced release date.

Patch 2.31 for Cyberpunk 2077 is now live!

This update includes an AutoDrive upgrade and Photo Mode adjustments. It also addresses common issues encountered by players. For details, check the full list of changes below:

Vehicles

  • Updated AutoDrive. When driving to a selected point, the vehicle now drives smoothly, overtakes blocking vehicles and no longer stops at traffic lights. Free Roam mode has also been upgraded to follow traffic rules and navigate the city more reliably.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where Johnny always spawned in the passenger seat when using the Delamain Cab service.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where applying CrystalCoat to the Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru caused its wheels to flash in different colors.

    [/*]

Photo Mode

  • Most of the new poses introduced in Update 2.3 now work with any gender.

    [/*]

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where some of the poses didn't work for Royce.

    [/*]

Quests & Open World

  • Freedom - Fixed the journal entry that appears when the player chooses not to steal the Rayfield Caliburn "Mordred."

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Fixed an issue where, after V fails to pursue and stop Semimaru and receives a text from River saying he'll contact V soon, the follow-up message never arrives.

    [/*]

    [/*]

    [/*]

  • Nitro (Youth Energy) - Fixed a game crash that could occur in certain circumstances after leaving the Yaiba showroom event.

    [/*]

    [/*]

Miscellaneous

  • Fixed several localization and lipsync issues in various languages.

    [/*]

  • Added a toggle to disable vignette. It can be found in Settings → Graphics → Basic.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue on PC and Mac where Ray-Traced Reflections might not display correctly when enabled under certain conditions.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several issues with displaying text messages from Delamain.

    [/*]

PC-specific

  • Selecting "Defaults" in Video Settings no longer turns HDR Mode off.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where setting the MetalFX DRS Maximum Resolution above the value applied by the “For this Mac” preset could cause visual artifacts.

    [/*]

  • Fixed the inverted behavior of the "Mute Game in Background" toggle in Settings.

    [/*]

  • Removed the outdated "(Requires Game Restart)" disclaimer from the mouseover description of the "Disable Spatial Audio" setting.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue on the App Store version that caused the game to become stuck on the “Press Space to continue” breaching screen.

    [/*]

  • Various stability and performance optimizations.

    [/*]

items.content:
Surviving the City of Dreams is tough, but a choom at your side can make all the difference.

In our latest It’s All About You episode, we’re celebrating all of our iconic duos living on the edge! Night City wouldn’t shine quite so bright without them. 

Thank you for staying with us and expressing your love for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners in the most creative ways possible. Don't forget to check out our gallery to see more works, and, of course, share your creations with us: http://cdpred.ly/AAY. See you in the next episode!

items.title: Update 2.3 Patch Notes

items.content:
Update 2.3 lands tomorrow!

Experience Night City in a whole new way — this patch introduces 4 new vehicles, the AutoDrive feature, self-driving Delamain cabs and more! It also contains updates for CrystalCoat™ and Photo Mode, as well as support for AMD FSR 3.1 Frame Generation, Intel XeSS 2.0 and HDR10+ Gaming, among others.

Update 2.3 also brings Cyberpunk 2077 to a whole new platform: Mac with Apple silicon! If you already own the game on Steam, you can play it on your compatible device. To find out whether your Mac can run Cyberpunk 2077, please check the official requirements.

Read the list of changes for more info:

Vehicles

  • Added 4 new vehicles, including several Side Jobs tied to acquiring them:

    • Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, complete The Hunt and The Beast In Me).

      An additional side job unlocks the CrystalCoat™ feature for it.

      [/*]

    • Rayfield Caliburn "Mordred"

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, complete The Beast in Me: Badlands, The Beast in Me: Santo Domingo, Transmission, and Search and Destroy)."

      [/*]

    • Yaiba ASM-R250 Muramasa

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, purchase 1 Yaiba vehicle, purchase at least 3 vehicles through AUTOFIXER, and complete Reported Crime: You Play with Fire...).

      If you fail the side job, the vehicle can later be purchased through AUTOFIXER.

      [/*]

    • Chevillon Legatus 450 Aquila

      Available for purchase on AUTOFIXER.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Introducing AutoDrive! This cutting-edge, autonomous driving feature will take you to your chosen destination (i.e. job objective or placed pin on the map). If you have no set destination, it will take you on a leisurely ride through the streets of Night City. Simply hop in any of your vehicles, make sure you're on a road, and hold G (PC) / Left Stick (consoles) to activate. This feature is disabled when you enter combat or when your vehicle is heavily damaged.

    [/*]

  • Implemented Cinematic Camera for AutoDrive. Hold Q (PC) / D-Pad Right (consoles) to activate. Sit back and enjoy cinematic views of Night City as you cruise toward your destination.

    [/*]

  • Self-driving Delamain cabs are now available on demand! Simply open the menu to call vehicles, then select "Delamain Cab" from the list to request a ride. This feature unlocks after completing the job Don't Lose Your Mind (regardless of outcome) and receiving a message from Delamain.

    [/*]

  • Rayfield's CrystalCoat™ is now available for vehicles from partner brands, including motorcycles. Additionally, the infamous hacker known as Cosmetic_Troll exploited a vulnerability and created a cracked version of Rayfield's CrystalCoat™ technology for lower-end vehicles. Please note, however, that some models do not support the technology, such as heavily modded nomad vehicles and job-related vehicles.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where unique color schemes did not work properly on the Mizutani Shion MZ1 and MZ2.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where unique color scheme could not be applied properly to the Villefort Deleon "Vindicator".

    [/*]

Photo Mode

  • Added 27 new NPCs that can be spawned in Photo Mode, including Rita Wheeler, the Cassel twins, fixers, Dum Dum, the iguana, Brendan, and more.

    [/*]

  • You can now switch between alternative outfits for NPCs spawned in Photo Mode.

    [/*]

  • You can now switch between V's saved Wardrobe outfits in Photo Mode.

    [/*]

  • Added a confirmation pop-up when exiting Photo Mode to prevent accidental exits after setting up the perfect shot.

    [/*]

  • Added more customization options to the Look-At Camera feature, including an option for only the character's eyes to turn toward the camera instead of their entire body.

    [/*]

  • Added improvements to Lighting:

    • Lights now spawn around the camera instead of the player character.

      [/*]

    • Added an outline to the spotlight mesh and an indicator when it's off screen for better visibility.

      [/*]

    • Improved light movement speed on controllers.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Added multiple new stickers and frames, including iconic quotes and stylish overlays that let you turn your screenshots into Night City postcards – perfect for sharing memories from the City of Dreams.

    [/*]

  • Improved Depth of Field and moved it to the Camera tab.

    [/*]

  • Added a new Color Balance tab, allowing you to create your own custom filters.

    [/*]

  • Added a new Time and Weather tab:

    • Weather: includes rain, acid rain, fog, sandstorm, pollution, and sunny.

      [/*]

    • Time of Day: changes the time of day within Photo Mode.

      [/*]

    • Frame Forward: advances through an unlimited amount of frames to capture the perfect shot.

      [/*]

    • Game Speed: allows in-game time to progress while in Photo Mode."

      [/*]
    [/*]

Quality of Life & Accessibility

  • The game will now detect if the player is using inverted mouse button settings and automatically adjusts in-game button prompts accordingly.

    [/*]

  • Added an option to toggle aiming down sights in Settings → Controls.

    [/*]

Jobs & Open World

  • Cyberpsycho Sighting: Bloody Ritual - the "Crack the ritualist's shard" objective now properly disappears from the Journal after completing the objective.

    [/*]

  • Sex on Wheels - now properly appears in the Journal after receiving the message from Jake Estevez.

    [/*]

  • Shot by Both Sides - fixed an issue where selecting a specific dialogue option in the conversation with Bree created a nameless, iconless item in the player's Inventory.

    [/*]

  • Shot by Both Sides - fixed an issue where the button to go to the lower level didn't appear on the elevator panel.

    [/*]

Gameplay

  • Fixed an issue where, when using a controller in Trauma Drama, the controllable character would default to shooting upwards instead of forward.

    [/*]

  • Players can now drop more Cyberware Capacity Shards if some within the intended drop limit were previously missed.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue causing automatic weapons to fire slower than intended.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where the Official BARGHEST Tac Vest didn't drop from the scripted Airdrop as intended.

    [/*]

  • The level 60 Engineer perk no longer activates the EMP blast outside of combat or after entering a vehicle.

    [/*]

  • Added an option to replay the gameplay tutorial at any time via Settings → Controls.

    [/*]

Miscellaneous

  • Added an option to tell Johnny to go away after you look at him for a short while when he appears in the passenger seat. He takes the hint and disappears as a passenger for a couple days.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where the sound of V's Radioport could be randomly interrupted by the Radioports of nearby NPCs.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where History by Gazelle Twin and Trash Generation played too loudly compared to other songs on the radio.

    [/*]

  • Improved the HDR Setting screen: fixed the HDR calibration preview so it correctly reflects the chosen settings, and clarified the description of the "Tone-Mapping Midpoint" setting.

    [/*]

  • Updated the End User Licence Agreement. You will be asked to accept it again when you load the game after updating.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several visual issues with missing, clipping, or floating textures.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several localization issues in various languages.

    [/*]

PC-specific

  • Added support for AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 4 for compatible AMD GPUs. IMPORTANT: The FSR 4 option will not be available in the in-game settings until the supporting AMD driver is installed. Please note that the driver will be released at a later date.

    [/*]

  • Added support for AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution Frame Generation 3.1 for compatible hardware. It can now be used in combination with any upscaler.

    [/*]

  • Added support for ​Intel XeSS 2.0, with XeSS Frame Generation available on compatible hardware.

    [/*]

  • Added support for HDR10+ GAMING certified Intel GPUs. To enable this feature, your display must support the technology (find my display) and have "Game Mode" enabled. The HDR10+ GAMING toggle can be found in Settings in the Video tab.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where the DLSS Super Resolution Preset would invisibly revert from the CNN model to the Transformer model after restarting the game, even though the UI still displayed the CNN model as active.

    [/*]

  • Added more detailed information to the DLSS Super Resolution Preset tooltip in Settings to help players choose the best option for their setup.

    [/*]

  • Added the ability to move the mouse cursor to a different display while in Windowed Borderless mode.

    [/*]

  • Increased the maximum save size from 12 MB to 15 MB.

    [/*]

  • It will now be possible to rebind the key used to jump out of vehicles with the Stuntjock perk.

    [/*]
